notes: ἀνυπόκριτος → without hypocrisy heads on hypocrisy under rule 84, and the supplied Let … be rides with the adjectival predicate under rules 53 and 15.

τό and τῷ are substantival articles before adjectives, so they keep that which under rules 22 and 31's verbless-modifier carve-out, headed on that (rule 77), and the copula goes with the adjective under rule 53.

The dative-realizing to of cleave to rides with the substantival article under rules 21 and 36; reading it as the verb's own phrasal particle remains defensible, and the unit note records it. The same analysis is taken at 12:16's τοῖς ταπεινοῖς.
